# spinviz ![spinviz logo](reference/figures/spinviz_logo.png)

The `spinviz` package provides tools for visualising sporting injury
frequencies as a **heatmap projected onto human-body SVG diagrams** in
`R`, and interactive **sunburst diagrams** of injury tissue/pathology
classifications.

The main function,
[`heatmap_diagram()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/heatmap_diagram.md),
colours anatomical regions by injury frequency and can render **front**,
**back**, or **both** views, using **male** or **female** body
templates.
[`sunburst_diagram_echarts()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/sunburst_diagram_echarts.md)
renders tissue types on an inner ring and pathologies on an outer ring.
Built-in taxonomies (`body_categories`, `injury_categories`), one-call
wrappers, and
[`save_diagram()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/save_diagram.md)
for correct-aspect-ratio export are also included.

Full documentation, tutorials, and a function reference live on the
[pkgdown site](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/).

## Installation

As this package is not currently on CRAN, install from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("bnqcasimiro/spinviz")
```

## Quick examples

**Heatmap diagram**

``` r

heatmap_diagram(df, "boxing", "front", sex = "male", show_scale = FALSE)
```

**`Example Diagrams`**

| Front (Male) | Back (Male) | Both Views (Male) |
|----|----|----|
| ![Injury heatmap, front view on male template](reference/figures/injury-heatmap-front.png) | ![Injury heatmap, back view on male template](reference/figures/injury-heatmap-back.png) | ![Injury heatmap, both views on male template](reference/figures/injury-heatmap-both.png) |

**Sunburst diagram**

``` r

sunburst_diagram_echarts(df, "boxing", plot_title = "Boxing Injuries")
```

**`Example Diagram`**

| Tissue/Pathology Sunburst |
|----|
| ![Sunburst diagram of tissue types and pathologies](reference/figures/sunburst-example.png) |

## Dependencies

Key packages used:

- Data wrangling: `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `rlang`, `stringr`
- SVG handling: `xml2`
- Iteration/utilities: `purrr`, `magrittr`
- Raster + plotting: `magick`, `ggplot2`, `grDevices`
- Combining plots: `patchwork`
- Interactive sunbursts: `echarts4r`, `htmlwidgets`
- Optional (sunburst file export only): `chromote`, `base64enc`

## Acknowledgements

`spinviz` builds on the foundations laid by the
[`injvis`](https://github.com/alexandraD03/injvis-R-Package) and
[`olympicinjuRies`](https://github.com/zachary-carr-student/COMP3850) R
packages. We thank Alexander Brinkman, Alexandra Dooley, Andisheh
Saffarian, Brice Thu, and Utsav Chadha (`injvis`), and Zoe Remo, Brayden
Smith, Govardhan Bharadwaj, Katja Amet, Kyle Mcnicholas, and Zachary
Carr (`olympicinjuRies`), for their work on those projects, which
provided the groundwork for this package.

# Package index

## Package

- [`spinviz-package`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/spinviz.md)
  [`spinviz`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/spinviz.md)
  : spinviz: Injury visualisation tools

## Diagrams

- [`heatmap_diagram()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/heatmap_diagram.md)
  : Heat map of Injuries on Human Body
- [`sunburst_diagram_echarts()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/sunburst_diagram_echarts.md)
  : Sunburst diagram
- [`save_diagram()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/save_diagram.md)
  : Save a spinviz diagram to file

## Convenience wrappers and taxonomies

- [`heatmap_diagram_default()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/heatmap_diagram_default.md)
  : Heatmap diagram using the built-in body region taxonomy
- [`sunburst_diagram_default()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/sunburst_diagram_default.md)
  : Sunburst diagram using the built-in injury taxonomy
- [`body_categories`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/body_categories.md)
  : Standard body region/body area injury taxonomy
- [`injury_categories`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/injury_categories.md)
  : Standard tissue/pathology injury taxonomy

## Importing data

- [`create_injury_template()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/create_injury_template.md)
  : Create a template CSV file for injury data
- [`create_sunburst_template()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/create_sunburst_template.md)
  : Create a template CSV file for sunburst injury data
- [`read_injury_data()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/read_injury_data.md)
  : Read and validate injury data from a CSV file
- [`read_sunburst_data()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/read_sunburst_data.md)
  : Read and validate sunburst injury data from a CSV file

## Palettes

  : Available colours in package
- [`test_colour()`](https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/reference/test_colour.md)
  : Test colour palette(s)
